text_block_list.text:
――"SETO." A keyword that might lead Neo Universe
somewhere other than the Classic Triple Crown.
The meaning remains unknown. However, with phrasing this distinct, we can investigate it thoroughly.

""SETO"... Come to think of it,
I heard rumors that a cat named "METO" lives on a ranch somewhere."

Or perhaps... "sweets" and "Shitu" sound similar.
Could there be some connection to sugary treats...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer. Doing some research?
You're so dedicated...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If you're having any trouble with anything,
I'd appreciate it if you told me...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes, what can I do for you...?
choice_data_list: I don't know... Not a clue...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Trainer-san?
Please don't cry, I'm begging you!

—Investigation abandoned. I searched through
every piece of literature regarding 'SETO',
but couldn't find even a shred of a clue...

Instead, I'll take another approach.
Time to ponder the 'Path to the Strongest.'

If only there were a promising route to head toward the Tenno Sho (Spring)
without going through the Classic Triple Crown...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"A route other than the Triple Crown? It feels presumptuous for someone like me
to talk about what's 'the strongest,'
but what comes to mind is..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—The Triple Tiara route.
—Skipping the Kikuka Sho in the autumn to enter the 2,000m
Tenno Sho (Autumn), merging into the Senior Class route.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...You've already scouted the area, right?

Of course, I considered taking on the Senior Class early.
However, I don't believe that would be
advantageous for tackling long distances in the future.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Other than that, there aren't really
any proper routes...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah! But wait!
As far as I know, there's definitely one person...
Saying that, Zenno Rob Roy opens the chronicle of the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "I found it! An Umamusume who completely skipped the Classic Triple Crown and kept racking up victory after victory taking the alternate route...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: And finally, she became known as one of the strongest...

Having received an important hint from Zenno Rob Roy,
I decided to introduce that Umamusume to Neo Universe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: A regional... racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Why in a place like this...?
Hey, hope I didn't keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: You are—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I intended to get here a little sooner...
but I got held up.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I was captured... by a "devotee"?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: No, towards a delicious-looking food stall.
choice_data_list: Thank you for coming, Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.text:
This Umamusume is Oguri Cap.
She started out in regional racing, but eventually came
to be hailed as a "Monster" even in the Central League.

A shadow king who ran down the hidden path of the Classic road.
Her experiences will surely be an immense help.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap.
You did not—participate in the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Still, I became stronger.
"STDA"... stronger than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe is aiming for certain coordinates.
To cross past them... she wants to get stronger."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Transmitting question. Will skipping the Classic Triple Crown
make one more "resilient"?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Skipping the Triple Crown, huh. True...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's true that due to various circumstances,
I did not run in the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And by summer, she was already mingling with her senior Umamusume,
competing fiercely for victory.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I think there was plenty I was able to learn thanks to that.
So, what if I had run
in the Classic Triple Crown—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: If I could just run, I would...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I would have been able to get stronger—much sooner.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "Yeah, because there were so many rivals in the Classic Triple Crown."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: If only we could have competed together, how fun that would have been.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If only we could have competed together, how many dreams
could we have shown them?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I didn't run in the Triple Crown, but I certainly don't believe that skipping it made me any stronger.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Competing against magnificent rivals on a magnificent stage. I know no better way to grow stronger than that.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Oguri—Cap...
Her words were profoundly persuasive. Straightforward words from one walking an unorthodox path, yet remaining untainted by heresy.
Distinct from mere intellect, her words carried a profound sense of righteousness.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: A wonderful rival... That is the "course" that yields the greatest thrust...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if I'm pushing through there and lacking speed,
the reason must be...”
choice_data_list: It might come down to how you run.
It might come down to how you run.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: How... do I 'run'?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it all depends on how we handle it.
Yeah, it all depends on how you do it.

text_block_list.text:
Your choice of career path alone doesn't determine everything.
What kind of effort you put in along that path is just as important.

No matter what the "future prediction" says,
we should still be able to change it.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap... Neo Universe conveys
a "thank you" to you.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
You are a "wise one."
I sense something "sublime" from you...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad if I could help.
But what about you...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
What could it be? Does it look delicious?
No, that's not it. But there's something...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"It feels familiar somehow.
I wonder why..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: “SETO”……。

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap...
You are “SETO”...
Seto...

I was surprised by what Neo Universe suddenly said.
I don't really get it, but Oguri Cap...

Apparently, it's the "SETO" she's been searching for.
At least, that's what Neo Universe felt.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
""SETO"... Haha, I see.
I certainly..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I like suiton dumplings. They are delicious.
Let us eat some on the way back.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Neo Universe has "made up their mind."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I will run in the Classic Triple Crown.
My rivals will be waiting there.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A rival... not yet "encountered."
Zenno Rob Roy will adjust in time
for the Japan Derby as well.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.text:
All hesitation is gone.
All that remains is to charge through the Classic Triple Crown.

First is the Satsuki Sho. From there,
let's accelerate toward next year's "GATE."
